summary: Pat Dixon objects to Texas doubling its Israel Bond investment to $280 million, framing the decision as taking sides in foreign policy rather than sound financial management (September 2026). The stated rationale is fiscal and sovereignty-based rather than grounded in Palestinian justice or any assessment of Israeli conduct in Gaza. As a Libertarian Party gubernatorial candidate in Texas, the objection reflects a non-interventionist posture toward state entanglement with Israel but does not constitute a position on the conflict itself.
